name: Ransomware Response
description: Standard response playbook for ransomware incidents — from initial detection through recovery and hardening.

data.label: Isolate Affected Systems
data.description: Disconnect infected hosts from the network (unplug cable / disable NIC). Do NOT power off — volatile memory may contain decryption keys.

data.label: Identify Ransomware Variant
data.description: Collect ransom note, encrypted file extension, and sample. Cross-reference with ID Ransomware / No More Ransom.

data.label: Preserve Forensic Evidence
data.description: Capture memory dump, disk image, and Windows event logs before any remediation. Hash all images.

data.label: Determine Blast Radius
data.description: Identify all encrypted shares, lateral movement paths, and compromised accounts. Map patient-zero host.

data.label: Restore from Backup
data.description: Validate backup integrity before restoration. Restore to a clean rebuild, not the infected OS.

data.label: Assess Decryption Options
data.description: Check No More Ransom for a free decryptor. Engage vendor support. Evaluate ransom payment risk with Legal.

data.label: Eradicate & Rebuild
data.description: Wipe and rebuild all infected hosts from golden images. Rotate all credentials. Revoke compromised certificates.

data.label: Notify Stakeholders
data.description: Brief management, legal, and communications. Assess regulatory notification obligations (GDPR, etc.).

data.label: Harden & Monitor
data.description: Apply patches, enforce MFA, review firewall rules and backup strategy. Deploy EDR on rebuilt hosts. Monitor for re-infection.

data.label: Post-Incident Review
data.description: Conduct root-cause analysis. Document timeline, impact, and remediation. Update IR playbooks and tabletops.
